params.name: LFO rate
params.desc: Adjusts the LFO frequency

params.name: LFO VCO amount
params.desc: Adjusts the modulation amount to the VCOs

params.name: LFO VCF amount
params.desc: Adjusts the modulation amount to the VCF

params.name: LFO MIDI sync
params.desc: Enables or disables syncing the LFO to MIDI clock messages

params.name: LFO sync clock div
params.desc: Sets the LFO sync clock divider

params.name: LFO key trigger
params.desc: Retriggers the LFO to the start of the cycle

params.name: VCO 1 wave
params.desc: Sets the waveform of VCO 1

params.name: VCO 2 wave
params.desc: Sets the waveform of VCO 2

params.name: VCO 2 frequency
params.desc: Adjusts the frequency of VCO 2

params.name: VCO 2 beat
params.desc: Adjusts the beat frequency of VCO 2 (default is 64)

params.name: Note sync
params.desc: Enables or disables note sync (default is off)

params.name: Glide rate
params.desc: Adjusts the glide (portamento) rate time

params.name: Glide switch
params.desc: Sets the state of the glide switch

params.name: Glide type
params.desc: Selects the type of glide: linear, constant rate, linear constant time, or exponential

params.name: Legato glide
params.usage: 0-63: Always glide; 64-127: Glide on legato notes only
params.desc: Sets the state of the legato glide parameter when glide is enabled

params.name: VCO 1 level
params.desc: Adjusts the level of VCO 1

params.name: VCO 2 level
params.desc: Adjusts the level of VCO 2

params.name: External In level
params.desc: Adjusts the level of the external audio input (default is 64 for 50% level)

params.name: Filter cutoff
params.desc: Adjusts the filter cutoff frequency

params.name: Filter resonance
params.desc: Adjusts the filter resonance parameter

params.name: Filter EG amount
params.desc: Adjusts the EG

params.name: Filter KB track
params.desc: Sets the amount of keyboard tracking for the filter (default is 32 - about 50%)

params.name: Filter velocity sensitivity
params.desc: Setgs the amount of filter velocity sensitivity (default is 64 for 50%)

params.name: VCF attack
params.desc: Adjusts the filter envelope attack time

params.name: VCF delay / release
params.desc: Adjusts the filter envelope decay and release time

params.name: VCF sustain
params.desc: Adjusts the filter envelope sustain level

params.name: VCA attack
params.desc: Adjusts the volume envelope attack time

params.name: VCA decay / release
params.desc: Adjusts the volume envelope decay and release time

params.name: CVA sustain
params.desc: Adjusts the volume envelope sustain level

params.name: Release switch
params.usage: 0-42: Legato on; 43-84: Legato off; 85-127: EG reset
params.desc: Sets the state of the release parameter

params.name: Trigger mode
params.desc: Sets the state of the envelope trigger

params.name: VCA (output) level
params.desc: Adjusts the audio output and the headphone volume

params.name: Volume velocity sensitivity
params.desc: Sets the amount of volume velocity sensitivity (default is 64 for 50%)

params.name: Key priority
params.desc: Sets the note priority (default is last)

params.name: Mod wheel
params.desc: Modulation performance control

params.name: Bend up amount
params.usage: 0-15: Off; 16-31: 2 semitones; 32-47: 3 semitones, 48-63: 4 semitones; 64-79: 5 semitones; 80-95: 7 semitones; 96-111: 12 semitones; 112-127: 24 semitones
params.desc: Pitch wheel up performance control (default is +3 semitones)

params.name: Bend down amount
params.usage: 0-15: Off; 16-31: 2 semitones; 32-47: 3 semitones, 48-63: 4 semitones; 64-79: 5 semitones; 80-95: 7 semitones; 96-111: 12 semitones; 112-127: 24 semitones
params.desc: Pitch wheel down performance control (default is -3 semitones)

params.name: Local control off
params.desc: Sets the state of the local control off parameter
